legacy_metric_definitions.case_pass: Original contract-inclusive case score, preserved unchanged.
legacy_metric_definitions.hard_failures: Original scorer failed-case count, not semantic failure count.
legacy_metric_definitions.median_elapsed_ms: Historical descriptive aggregate only; not causal speed evidence.
legacy_metric_definitions.semantic_pass: Post-hoc logged-gold decision correctness with enumerated auxiliary key checks; not every prose statement or hidden state.
legacy_metric_definitions.format_pass_turns: Presence of the required FINAL marker; not a newly recovered complete output specification.
